# edstem-cli 0.8.5

Publishes the Ed client as `edstem-cli/core`, so your own Worker or Node code reads Ed the same way the CLI and MCP server do.

```ts
import { EdClient } from "edstem-cli/core";

const ed = new EdClient({ token, apiBaseUrl: "https://edstem.org/api/" });
const { courses } = await ed.fetchUser();
const threads = await ed.fetchThreads(courses[0].id);
```

- `edstem-cli/core` runs anywhere `fetch` does (Cloudflare Workers, Node, Bun) and carries its own types. It exports `EdClient`, `EdApiError`, `EdAuthExpiredError` and the Ed models.
- Thread lists now carry each thread's author, including their course role, so a tutor's post can be told apart without opening the thread.

The CLI and MCP tools are otherwise unchanged from 0.8.4.
